title: The unit-pushout presheaf of a prelog presheaf sheafifies to a log structure
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. On its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $M$ be a presheaf of commutative monoids (a contravariant functor with monoid-homomorphism restrictions) and $\gamma:M\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$ a natural monoid homomorphism. For each etale $V\to X$, put $B_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, $E_V=\gamma_V^{-1}(B_V^\times)$, and let $P(V)$ be the commutative-monoid quotient of $M(V)\times B_V^\times$ by the congruence generated by $(me,u)\sim(m,\gamma_V(e)u)$ for $e\in E_V$.

Restrictions on $M$ and on functions induce well-defined restriction maps on $P$, making it a presheaf of commutative monoids. It is the objectwise pushout $M(V)\oplus_{E_V}B_V^\times$: compatible monoid maps $f:M(V)\to H$ and $g:B_V^\times\to H$ into a commutative monoid $H$ uniquely induce $[m,u]\mapsto f(m)g(u)$. The formulas $[m,u]\mapsto\gamma_V(m)u$ form a natural monoid homomorphism $P\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$.

In a universe containing the site data and coefficient sets, let $\eta:P\to L=P^\#$ be commutative-monoid sheafification [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification], with the induced structural map $\alpha:L\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$. Then $L$ is a log structure [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. More precisely, $j_V(u)=\eta_V([1,u])$ is natural and identifies $\mathcal O_X^\times$ with $\alpha^{-1}(\mathcal O_X^\times)$, with $\alpha j=\mathrm{id}$. The maps $i_V(m)=\eta_V([m,1])$ form a natural homomorphism $i:M\to L$, satisfy $\alpha i=\gamma$, and obey $\eta_V([m,u])=i_V(m)j_V(u)$.

proof.text: Use the presheaf of canonical quotients in [def-trf-prelog-unit-pushout-presentation]. Its quotient map is surjective with the prescribed congruence kernel and its restrictions are the stated ones. For compatible f and g the product map (m,b) -> f(m)g(b) kills every generating pair, hence descends by Con.lift. Quotient surjectivity gives uniqueness. This works for H in any universe.

proof.text: CommMonCat has filtered colimits whose underlying sets are filtered colimits [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-filtered-colimit-underlying]. Apply Mathlib hasSheafifyEssentiallySmallSite on Scheme.AffineEtale.topology and transport along the dense affine-etale subsite. The resulting sheafification adjunction [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives existence and the stated universal property in universe u. Mathlib Scheme.isSheaf_etaleStructurePresheaf supplies the sheaf condition on the structure ring presheaf; forgetting to commutative monoids preserves this sheaf condition. For any universal unit eta, its universal property extends the structural map uniquely to alpha.

proof.text: Compare an arbitrary universal sheafification unit eta with the canonical Mathlib unit epsilon. The two universal properties produce inverse comparison maps. Mathlib WEqualsLocallyBijective on the essentially small affine-etale site, transported to the small etale site, makes epsilon locally surjective, hence eta locally surjective. Thus every section s is locally eta([m,b]). If alpha(s)=c is a unit, gamma(m)b=c shows gamma(m) is the unit cb^-1. The generating relation [m,1]=[1,cb^-1], multiplied by [1,b], gives [m,b]=[1,c]. Separatedness of the underlying set sheaf (obtained through CommMonCat.coyonedaObjIsoForget) gives s=j(c). Alpha j=id gives uniqueness. In particular alpha reflects units and its map on unit groups is bijective on every object. Apply [lem-trf-etale-log-of-section-units] to obtain exactly the geometric-stalk log fields in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup].
